title: AI Retro Futurism Generator
summary: Make retro futurism art with AI. Describe the future as the 1950s saw it, pick a retro-futuristic style, and Flick makes rockets, robots and chrome cities.
body_markdown:
### How do I make retro futurism art with AI?


Describe a scene of tomorrow with period props, such as a chrome monorail between streamlined towers, add how it was made, such as a 1950s magazine cover painting, pick a retro-futuristic style, and generate. In Flick you can then animate the still into a clip.


### What is the difference between retro futurism and atompunk?


Atompunk is a branch of retro futurism focused on the 1950s atomic age: ray guns, atoms, tail fins and space race imagery, while retro futurism covers any past vision of the future, from 1930s art deco cities to 1960s space homes.


### Can I make a retro futurism video, not just an image?


Yes. Generate the still first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick, and describe the motion, such as the monorail gliding past or the rocket lifting off.


### What colours are used in retro futurism?


Retro futurism leans on cream, white and polished chrome with bright accents of coral, teal, turquoise, mustard and cherry red, usually in clear daylight with soft airbrushed gradients.


### Is the retro futurism generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every week with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
